stats.text: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage (your choice) to the creature, and you can expend one of your {ref:glossary/hit-point-dice} to roll it and regain a number of {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point).
